summary: Tested warehouses/regions/delivery-display features end-to-end. Backend 13/16 pytest pass (core CRUD, receipts, writeoff guard, transfer, delete-with-stock guard, delivery-display roundtrip, COGS/reserve regression all OK). Admin UI: warehouses CRUD, receipt with warehouse select + region chips, quick receipt/writeoff with mv-warehouse-select, transfer modal, Delivery tab (save + persists after reload, live preview), product form (no stock toggle, no delivery days, info block) all work. Client: region-selector + region-menu work on desktop, DeliveryBadge on ProductPage recalculates green/yellow correctly. BUT: catalog listing does NOT use the new DeliveryBadge (CatalogPage has its own local ProductCard with legacy 'N дн.' badge; components/ProductCard.js is imported nowhere), legacy product stock is not migrated to stock_levels (4/7 products), region not persisted server->client (/auth/me lacks region), region selector missing on mobile.

critical.issue: No migration of legacy products.stock into stock_levels. 4 of 7 products (E82KPD36=13, E89HD734=3, 03434302100=14, PL270x=1) have stock>0 but no stock_levels rows. Consequences: (a) stock_regions empty -> client sees red 'Под заказ' for in-stock items; (b) any receipt/movement calls recompute_product_stock which sets stock=sum(levels) -> legacy stock silently LOST; (c) writeoff/transfer impossible for these (no warehouse qty); (d) orders: allocate_stock returns None -> no stock decrement and no 'sale' movement -> COGS/profit miss these sales.

critical.endpoint: admin.py PUT /admin/orders/{id} (cancel ~l.423), PUT status cancel (~l.480), DELETE /admin/orders/{id} (~l.590), server.py auto-cancel jobs (~l.55, ~l.93)
critical.issue: Stock restore still uses legacy $inc products.stock instead of _restore_order_stock/stock_allocations. stock_levels not restored, stock_regions not updated; restored units are wiped on next recompute. Only orders.py client cancel uses the new helper.

minor.issue: UserResponse has no 'region' field, so PUT /me/region is saved in DB but never returned; RegionContext seed-from-profile never works (verified: new browser session shows 'Выберите регион' after region was set to Ростов). Region persists only via localStorage.

Admin product form still sends 'stock' (stale value) in payload and ProductUpdate accepts it -> overwrites products.stock bypassing stock_levels. Also CSV import (products.py ~l.798) and product create set stock directly. Should drop 'stock' from ProductUpdate/Create or ignore it.
to_warehouse_id/product_id not validated: transfer to nonexistent warehouse returns 200 and creates phantom stock_levels row (units disappear from regions). Return 404.

Non-numeric days_min -> 500 (int() ValueError). No validation days_min<=days_max (UI preview shows '18.11 – 15.11'); no hex color validation (badge uses color+'55' alpha suffix, breaks for non-6-hex).
Returns 200 for nonexistent id (no 404). Writeoff/transfer decrements are non-atomic (check-then-$inc) - race can go negative; use conditional update {quantity:{$gte:qty}}.

ui_bugs.issue: Catalog uses its own local ProductCard (CatalogPage.js l.46) with legacy getDeliveryBadge(product.delivery_days) -> shows '4 дн.'/'3 дн.' with same testid delivery-badge-<id>; region-based badge never shown in listings. components/ProductCard.js (with DeliveryBadge) is not imported anywhere. List view (l.424) shows 'Доставка: N дней' from delivery_days; filters 'СКЛАД' (legacy product.warehouse string, e.g. 'Казань' for a product actually in Ростов) and 'СРОК ДОСТАВКИ', and sort 'По скорости доставки' still use legacy delivery_days/warehouse fields.
RegionSelector rendered only inside 'hidden md:flex' desktop block; at 390px it's not visible and not in mobile menu -> mobile clients cannot choose region.

mv-warehouse-select defaults to warehouses[0] (Основной склад with 0 qty) instead of empty/warehouse that holds stock -> immediate 'На складе «Основной склад» только 0 шт.' error. Default to product's warehouse with stock for writeoff.

integration_issues.issue: Region chosen by client saved to DB but not restored on new device/session because /auth/me doesn't return region.

issues: DeliveryBadge (size lg) in narrow 'Доставка' card wraps label into 3 lines and date '· 14.11' floats separately; allow full width or put date on its own line.
Region is free-text input - typos/case ('Москва' vs 'москва') create separate regions and break in_region matching; use select/autocomplete of existing regions.
Native <select> used for rc-warehouse/mv-warehouse-select/tr-from/tr-to instead of shadcn Select (consistency).

action_items: CRITICAL: write idempotent migration: for every product with stock>0 and no stock_levels, create a stock_levels row on a default warehouse (e.g. 'Основной склад'), then recompute_product_stock.

CRITICAL: replace legacy delivery_days badge in CatalogPage local ProductCard (grid+list) with <DeliveryBadge stockRegions={product.stock_regions} productId={product.id}/>; update/remove 'Склад' and 'Срок доставки' filters and 'По скорости доставки' sort to use region-based state; delete or use components/ProductCard.js.
HIGH: use _restore_order_stock (stock_allocations) in admin.py cancel/delete paths and server.py auto-cancel jobs.
HIGH: add RegionSelector to mobile menu.
Add 'region' to UserResponse so /auth/me returns it.
Ignore/remove 'stock' in ProductCreate/ProductUpdate payloads (admin form sends stale stock); handle CSV import stock via stock_levels.
Validate transfer to_warehouse_id/product_id exist (404); validate delivery-display ints (400) and days_min<=days_max; 404 on deleting missing warehouse; atomic conditional decrements.
Writeoff modal: default warehouse to one that holds stock.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/warehouse.py is 788 lines - split warehouses/regions/delivery-display into separate module.
allocate_stock does find then multiple $inc without condition - concurrent orders may oversell; use $inc with {quantity:{$gte:take}} filter.
list_warehouses runs one aggregate per warehouse (N+1) - single $group by warehouse_id.
Old tests (test_warehouse_receipts_cogs.py, test_warehouse_finance.py, test_stock_sync.py) likely post movements/receipts without warehouse_id and will now 422 - update them.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% - admin flows all pass; client listing badge and mobile selector fail

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created/deleted TEST_ warehouses (API + UI 'TEST_UI_WH'), receipts/writeoffs on product 04362a26 (Датчик SIEMENS 03434365000) netted back to Ростов:5 (receipt docs/movements with supplier TEST_* remain in history). Removed phantom stock_levels row created by transfer-to-nonexistent test. Delivery-display settings restored to original. user@demo.com region reset to ''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Warehouses: Основной склад(Москва, 9bcf5eec), Основной Москва(Москва, eaa8b03e), Склад Ростов(Ростов, 1e27d6f7). Only product 04362a26 has stock_levels (Ростов:5). Admin warehouse UI: /admin -> tab role=tab name 'Склад' -> warehouse-tab-<id>. Product edit button testid edit-<productId>. Catalog listing: /catalog then click 'Все товары'. Region badge only on /product/<id> currently. Run: pytest tests/test_warehouses_regions_delivery.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''.
rca of the issue: Catalog badge: E1 added DeliveryBadge to components/ProductCard.js, but the catalog renders a local ProductCard defined inside CatalogPage.js, so the component edit had no effect. Legacy stock: new model derives products.stock from stock_levels, but existing stock was never seeded into stock_levels; recompute overwrites it. Region persistence: UserResponse pydantic model strips 'region'.
